instruction: I want to change the font for all slide titles in my presentation to 'DejaVu Sans'. How can I do this efficiently without editing each slide individually?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all title fonts in a 28-slide presentation to DejaVu Sans. Evaluator extracts fonts used in title placeholders and verifies only 'DejaVu Sans' is present.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly iterates through all slides and extracts fonts from title placeholders (types 1 and 3 for title and center title)
Metric correctly verifies that only 'DejaVu Sans' font is present in the result set using exact set comparison
Postconfig properly saves the file before verification to ensure changes are persisted
Complete coverage: evaluator checks ALL slide titles across the 28-slide presentation
Data flow is semantically correct: getter returns set of fonts, metric compares against expected single-font set
Edge cases handled: checks for None font names, uses set to deduplicate across slides
State accessibility: file is saved and downloaded from VM for reliable analysis
